in_hebrew.name: אלענה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Oleana is derived from the Hebrew word 'elana', which means 'oil' or 'fresh olive'. This name could have been given to a child born during the olive harvest season, or to one who was anointed with oil as a sign of God's favor.

in_greek.name: Ὀλεάνη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Oleana is derived from the word 'oleáne', which means 'oil' or 'olive tree'. This name is also associated with the goddess Athena, who was often depicted carrying an olive tree or an olive branch as a symbol of peace and wisdom.

in_latin.name: Oleana
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Oleana is derived from the word 'oleum', which means 'oil'. This name could have been given to someone who was associated with the production or use of olive oil, which was a valuable commodity in ancient Rome.
